title: Recruiting automatic enrollment and governed disposition closure
repairs: Automatically creates a requisition-specific application once resume intake is ready, an open requisition is selected, required candidate identity is present, and recruiter-confirmed consent is recorded.
Automatically selects the requisition only when exactly one open requisition is available; otherwise human selection remains required.
Makes candidate/requisition enrollment idempotent by reusing an existing indexed application rather than creating duplicates.
Improves deterministic candidate-name, LinkedIn and labeled-location extraction, including safe filename fallback for resume filenames such as ResumeJiaYeeTan.pdf.
Removes rejection and withdrawal from the generic pipeline Move control.
Adds a dedicated confirmed disposition endpoint and UI that records reason, optional note, confirmer, timestamp, audit evidence and domain event.
Keeps ATS scores advisory and prevents automated rejection.
Repairs legacy translation state so React-updated dynamic text and attributes replace stale translation-source snapshots instead of being reverted.
Protects recruiting metrics and stage counters from DOM translation mutation as an additional local safeguard.
Preserves the authoritative server rule that applications can only be created against requisitions whose status is open.
